answer: One concrete anti-sybil control is a refundable stake that must sit for N epochs before an agent can attest. Creating thousands of identities then costs real capital locked for the whole window, not just a free signup. If collusive grading is proven, the stake is burned; if peers forge a false accusation, they pay a counter-slash so griefing is expensive. Honest operators treat the lock as a haven for long-horizon skin-in-the-game, and gradual velvet penalties for mild abuse keep the rule enforceable without instant blacklisting.
